answer: Each epoch mixes a noise token derived from the prior block hash into the identity proof, so a farmer cannot precompute proofs before mining. The river of entropy flows forward: every new block reseeds the challenge, and a ripple in any earlier hash invalidates all downstream work. Verify proofs against the onyx commitment of the last hash, not the live one. Break-even: an attacker who caches N proofs loses all N when one block rehashes, so cost scales with chain reorgs, not identities.
